bind_address.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) to bind the server to. Default: 127.0.0.1 (IPv4) or ::1 (IPv6).

bind_port.description: TCP port to bind the server to.

allow_hosts.description: List of hosts (IPs or CIDR ranges) allowed to connect, comma-separated in rendered output.

allow_file.description: Path to a file containing allowed hosts (one per line or comma/whitespace-separated).

deny_hosts.description: List of hosts (IPs or CIDR ranges) denied from connecting, comma-separated in rendered output.

deny_file.description: Path to a file containing denied hosts.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections accepted. Default: 100.

verbose.description: Enable verbose output and debug logging to $HOME/asndebug.log.
